definitions.name: Award leaders
definitions.expression: VAR c=SELECTEDVALUE('Classification'[Classification]) VAR leaders=CALCULATETABLE(FILTER(ALL('Rider'),[Classification Rank]=1),REMOVEFILTERS('Rider'),REMOVEFILTERS('Stage')) VAR score=MAXX(leaders,SWITCH(c,"Points",[Cumulative Points],"Mountains",[Cumulative KOM Points],[Rider Cumulative Seconds])) RETURN IF(c IN {"Points","Mountains"},LOOKUPVALUE('Jersey Leaders'[Leader],'Jersey Leaders'[Stage],[As of Stage Number],'Jersey Leaders'[Classification],c),IF(NOT ISBLANK(score),CONCATENATEX(leaders,'Rider'[Rider],", ",'Rider'[Bib],ASC)))
definitions.description: Full-field leaders through the selected stage. Points and Mountains use published first-place snapshots including official tie-breaks.

definitions.name: Winning score
definitions.expression: VAR c=SELECTEDVALUE('Classification'[Classification]) VAR leaders=CALCULATETABLE(FILTER(ALL('Rider'),[Classification Rank]=1),REMOVEFILTERS('Rider'),REMOVEFILTERS('Stage')) VAR exportedScore=MAXX(leaders,SWITCH(c,"Points",[Cumulative Points],"Mountains",[Cumulative KOM Points],[Rider Cumulative Seconds])) VAR score=IF(c IN {"Points","Mountains"},LOOKUPVALUE('Jersey Leaders'[Points],'Jersey Leaders'[Stage],[As of Stage Number],'Jersey Leaders'[Classification],c),exportedScore) RETURN IF(NOT ISBLANK(score),IF(c IN {"Points","Mountains"},FORMAT(score,"0") & " pts",FORMAT(INT(score/3600),"0") & ":" & FORMAT(INT(MOD(score,3600)/60),"00") & ":" & FORMAT(MOD(score,60),"00")))

definitions.name: Winning rule
definitions.expression: SWITCH(SELECTEDVALUE('Classification'[Classification]),"General","Lowest total adjusted time","Points","Highest sprint/finish points; official tie-breaks","Mountains","Highest climb-points total; official tie-breaks","Young Rider","Lowest total adjusted time; born on or after 1 Jan 2000")
